name: 4D Hyper-Mesh
description: Real-time 4D Polychoron (600-cell & 120-cell) with hyper-rotations and Hopf fibration coloring.

parameters.name: Rotate XW
parameters.description: Primary 4D hyper-rotation through the XW plane (continuous inside-out cell inversion).

parameters.name: Rotate YW
parameters.description: Secondary 4D hyper-rotation through the YW plane.

parameters.name: Rotate ZW
parameters.description: Tertiary 4D hyper-rotation through the ZW plane.

parameters.name: Rotate X
parameters.description: 3D Pitch rotation of the projected object.

parameters.name: Rotate Y
parameters.description: 3D Yaw rotation of the projected object.

parameters.name: Rotate Z
parameters.description: 3D Roll rotation of the projected object.

parameters.name: Camera Dist
parameters.description: 4D lens distance (d in x,y,z / (d - w)). Low values explode inner cells; high values approach orthographic projection.

parameters.name: Projection Mode
parameters.description: 0.0 = 4D Perspective Projection, 1.0 = Stereographic S3 -> R3 conformal projection.

parameters.name: Thickness
parameters.description: Width of the strut edges in screen space.

parameters.name: Node Size
parameters.description: Size of the vertex joint spheres/nodes.

parameters.name: Hue Offset
parameters.description: Base hue shift for palette mapping.

parameters.name: Hue Spread
parameters.description: Spread of colors across Hopf fibration circles and W-depth.

parameters.name: Color Mode
parameters.description: 0 = Hopf Fibration Coordinates, 1 = 4D W-Depth, 2 = 3D Spatial Position.

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Neon halo bloom and edge glow intensity.

parameters.name: Depth Fog
parameters.description: Fog falloff attenuation based on 3D distance from viewer.
